# transplantR

Functions for transplant medicine and nephrology, including clinical
risk indices, kidney function calculations, data extraction, and
visualization tools.

## Features

### Clinical Risk Assessment

- **KDRI 2012** - Kidney Donor Risk Index (2012 version)
- **KDRI 2019** - Updated Kidney Donor Risk Index with risk
  categorization
- **GFR Calculation** - CKD-EPI 2021 equation for estimated glomerular
  filtration rate

### Data Processing

- **PDF Extraction** - Extract donor data from TransplantPath PDF
  reports with regex parsing
- **Cumulative Analysis** - Create time-series datasets for transplant
  activity tracking

### Visualization

- **Cumulative Plots** - Year-over-year comparison charts with automatic
  labeling

## Installation

``` r

# Install from source
devtools::install_github("Laszlo75/transplantR")

# Or install locally
devtools::install()
```

## Usage

### Calculate KDRI scores

``` r

library(transplantR)

# KDRI 2012
kdri_2012 <- calc_kdri2012(
  donor_age_year = 45,
  donor_hypertension = "NO",
  donor_weight = 75,
  donor_days_in_hospital = 2,
  donor_adrenaline = "NO"
)

# KDRI 2019
kdri_2019 <- calc_kdri2019(
  donor_age_year = 55,
  donor_height = 175,
  donor_hypertension = "NO",
  donor_sex = "MALE",
  donor_cmv = "Negative",
  donor_egfr = 85,
  donor_days_in_hospital = 3
)

# Get risk category
calc_kdri2019_category(kdri_2019)
```

### Calculate GFR

``` r

# CKD-EPI 2021 equation
gfr <- calculate_gfr(
  creatinine = 85,  # μmol/L
  age = 50,
  sex = "MALE"
)
```

### Extract donor data from PDFs

``` r

# Extract from folder of TransplantPath reports
donor_data <- extract_donor_data_from_pdfs("path/to/pdf/folder")
```

### Create cumulative visualization

``` r

# Prepare data
cum_df <- create_cumulative_df(
  transplants_df,
  report_year = 2025,
  report_month = 4
)

# Generate plot
plot_cumulative(
  cum_df,
  report_year = 2025,
  report_month = 4
)
```

## Data Privacy

This package provides tools for analyzing transplant data but does
**NOT** include any patient data. Users are responsible for ensuring
GDPR and data protection compliance when using this package with real
patient data.

**Important:** Never commit patient data or PDF files containing patient
information to version control.

# Package index

## Clinical Risk Assessment

Functions for calculating clinical risk indices and kidney function
metrics

- [`calc_kdri2012()`](https://laszlo75.github.io/transplantR/reference/calc_kdri2012.md)
  : Calculate KDRI 2012
- [`calc_kdri2019()`](https://laszlo75.github.io/transplantR/reference/calc_kdri2019.md)
  : Calculate KDRI 2019
- [`calc_kdri2019_category()`](https://laszlo75.github.io/transplantR/reference/calc_kdri2019_category.md)
  : Calculate KDRI 2019 Category
- [`calculate_gfr()`](https://laszlo75.github.io/transplantR/reference/calculate_gfr.md)
  : Calculate GFR from creatinine

## Data Extraction

Tools for extracting donor data from PDF reports

- [`extract_donor_data_from_pdfs()`](https://laszlo75.github.io/transplantR/reference/extract_donor_data_from_pdfs.md)
  : Extract donor data from PDF reports

## Data Processing

Functions for preparing transplant activity data

- [`create_cumulative_df()`](https://laszlo75.github.io/transplantR/reference/create_cumulative_df.md)
  : Monthly cumulative transplant counts

## Visualization

Plotting functions for transplant reporting

- [`plot_cumulative()`](https://laszlo75.github.io/transplantR/reference/plot_cumulative.md)
  : Cumulative transplant comparison plot
